description: This file defines an interface and related classes for transactional state storage in Orleans. It includes methods for loading and storing transactional state, as well as classes representing pending transactions, storage responses, and metadata.

classes.name: PendingTransactionState
classes.description: Represents a pending transaction with its sequence id, transaction id, timestamp, optional transaction manager, and the snapshot of its state.

classes.name: TransactionalStorageLoadResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the response from loading transactional storage, including ETag, committed state, pending states, and metadata.

classes.name: TransactionalStateMetaData
classes.description: Holds metadata for transactional state storage, including timestamp and commit records.

classes.name: CommitRecord
classes.description: Records details of a commit, including timestamp and participants involved.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current transactional state, returning a response object.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Asynchronously stores the specified transactional state, with options for expected ETag, metadata, prepared states, commit, and abort options.
